ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Privilege Escalation Using Symlink Between Osk and Cmd
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a symbolic link between "cmd.exe" and the accessibility on-screen keyboard binary (osk.exe) using "mklink". This technique provides an elevated command prompt to the user from the login screen without the need to log in.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*mklink.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\osk\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\cmd\\\.exe.*")))
